page.layout: One printed page, title page, all lines centred in one column; a library ownership stamp (round seal) overlaps the right side of the text and a handwritten shelf mark sits at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Societatis Jesu et Controversiarum fidei in Schola Friburgensi apud Helvetios Professore, in lucem editorum, & disputatione secunda propositorum
In Illustri Athenaeo Bernensi sacro-sanctae Theologiae Professore publico.
In qua ostenditur Parallelorum futilitas, & fidei Ecclesiae reformatarum antiquitas, & cum vera Dei conformitas.
Laudatis semper antiquitate, & nove de die vivitiu.
Excudebat ILLUSTRISSIMAE REIPUBLICAE, Bernensis Typographus, Georgius Sonnleitnerus.

page.notes: The seal overlaps the text at the right, so the ends of lines 'Parallel[orum]', 'Eccles[iae]' and 'cum v[era]' are partly hidden and read from context [?]. The handwritten shelf mark "A: 4626723" at the foot is not transcribed. Some lines are in italic and mixed type; the Latin title words are reproduced as printed.
